summary: The admitted v47 case reaches uhitm.c:gulpum() at segment 0 step 76. Its successful AD_DREN roll calls mhitm.c:xdrainenergym(), which adds d(2,2) to the eligible kobold shaman and prints the lethargy message. The corrected M2M recording reaches uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren() at segment 0 step 74, but rn2(4)=2 fails its gate, so that recording does not call xdrainenergym(). The energy-vortex monster-to-hero engulf path is mhitu.c:gulpmu() and calls drain_en(); it is outside this source scope.

source.branch: mhitm.c:xdrainenergym() checks mspec_used < 20 and AT_MAGC or AT_BREA, adds d(2,2), and calls pline_mon() when givemsg is true. Its direct calls include uhitm.c:gulpum() for hero polymorph engulfing and uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren() for hero-attacker and M2M AD_DREN attacks. mhitu.c:gulpmu() handles an energy-vortex monster engulfing the hero through drain_en(), not xdrainenergym().
callers: uhitm.c:gulpum() AD_DREN branch (5174-5177) calls xdrainenergym(mdef, TRUE) after a successful rn2(4); the admitted v47 prefix executes the helper at segment 0 step 76.

uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren() (2418-2442) calls xdrainenergym() for eligible hero-attacker and M2M AD_DREN hits. uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping() dispatches AD_DREN to this helper. The matching M2M recording reaches the resolver at step 74 but rn2(4)=2 prevents the nested xdrainenergym() call.

uhitm.c:damageum(), mhitm.c:mdamagem(), and mhitu.c:hitmu() call uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping(); their JavaScript equivalents retain this shared dispatcher. The energy-vortex monster-to-hero engulf path is mhitu.c:gulpmu() -> drain_en(), outside this selected helper path.
dependencies: mondata.c:attacktype() is a pure catalog helper implemented by js/mondata.js.
rng.c:d() and rn2() are implemented by js/rng.js.
pline.c:pline_mon() is implemented by js/pline.js and carries the target monster location.
uhitm.c:mhitm_mgc_atk_negated() returns the cancellation result used by mhitm_ad_dren(); js/uhitm.js already implements it.
trap.c:drain_en() is called only in the hero-defender branch of mhitm_ad_dren(); js/trap_effects.js implements it.
uhitm.c:hitmsg() and display.c:canspotmon() are already wired in js/uhitm.js and js/display.js.
